title: Apixaban for the treatment of venous thromboembolism: eight trials report an outcome named for recurrent VTE, and three of them count the same thing
question: In adults with acute or recent venous thromboembolism, what is the effect of apixaban compared with conventional anticoagulation, another direct oral anticoagulant, or placebo on recurrent venous thromboembolism and on bleeding?
question_provenance: One of the two readings `apixaban-vte` was split into on 2026-08-19. The parent's question was the OBJECT'S OWN VERDICT with a question mark appended -- 'NOT POOLABLE AS POSED...?' -- which no lint could see because the string appears in no registry record. Both readings are built; neither was chosen over the other.

split_provenance.why_split: The parent asked one question of two evidence bases of almost equal size -- 34 trials coded TREATMENT and 33 coded PREVENTION -- and its two included trials fall on opposite sides. See BLOCKED-apixaban-vte-2026-08-19.md. P21.

shared_trials.computed_over: the two objects' own included NCT sets: 4 here against 5 there, intersected. Not asserted.
shared_trials.why_empty_is_a_result_and_not_a_blank: The boundary criterion assigns every trial to exactly one of the two reviews, so the intersection is EMPTY BY CONSTRUCTION and the emptiness is computed rather than left as a bare `[]`. P17. The corpus-level consequence is the good one: summing k across these two topics does NOT double-count, which is the opposite of the ablation split's situation.

withholding_question.question: does each trial report a recurrent-VTE efficacy outcome at ANY registered rank -- primary, secondary or other -- before concluding which trials can be combined?
withholding_question.answer: YES AT EVERY RANK, AND THE ANSWER DOES NOT SETTLE POOLABILITY
withholding_question.what_asking_it_bought_and_what_it_did_no: IT BOUGHT THE REVIEW ITS ENTIRE POOL. All three contributing results were found by asking at every rank: two of the three are SECONDARY outcomes in trials whose registered PRIMARY is a bleeding endpoint, so a review reading primaries only would have reported that they contribute nothing. IT DID NOT BUY POOLABILITY: eight trials answered yes and five of the eight still do not pool; the coherence_screen records why: NCT00643201 and NCT00633893 have no recurrent-VTE measure without a death term, NCT04168203 and NCT03196349 are extended-anticoagulation trials rather than acute-treatment trials, and NCT02744092 posts a percentage for a drug-class contrast rather than an arm-level apixaban count. The prophylaxis half of this pair ran the identical discipline and its poolable set went 3 -> 8. HERE IT WENT 8 -> 3. THE METHOD HAS NO DIRECTION -- asking is not a way of finding more trials, it is a way of finding out.

direction.direction: DOWN -- the question DISSOLVED a pool
direction.detail: Eight trials with posted results report an outcome named for recurrent VTE. Reading what each one COUNTS leaves three. The two largest trials in the field, AMPLIFY and AMPLIFY-EXT, post no recurrent-VTE measure without a death term at any registered rank.

counter_instance.direction: UP -- the question RECOVERED a pool
counter_instance.detail: Four trials register four different primary composites and would not pool. All four also register proximal DVT, non-fatal PE, or VTE-related death, at SECONDARY rank in every one. Four trials and 13,570 participants, available only because someone asked below the primary.

direction.why_both_are_stated_together: THE SAME QUESTION, ASKED THE SAME WAY, ON THE SAME DRUG, ON THE SAME NIGHT, MOVED ONE REVIEW'S POOLABLE SET UP AND THE OTHER'S DOWN. Every earlier instance in this corpus recovered a pool, and a check that has only ever returned the convenient answer cannot be told apart from no check at all. This pair is the refutation, and it arose on its own rather than being sought: it cost the treatment review the two largest trials in its field. Asking the withholding question is not a way of finding more trials. It is a way of finding out.
direction.what_it_does_not_establish: NOT that either pool is correct -- both were judged by reading endpoint definitions, and that judgement stands or falls on its own. NOT that the direction is unpredictable in general; two instances are two instances. What it establishes is narrow and it is the thing that was missing: THE PROCEDURE HAS NO BUILT-IN DIRECTION, demonstrated rather than asserted.

On the same page, the pool this review DECLINES whose estimand IS shared comes out at 93.5% -- higher than the name-matched pool whose estimands agree on nothing. sensitivity.decision_under_test: Does the reported estimate depend on any one of the three trials? At k=3 that is not a formality: the largest contributor is more than seven times the size of the other two together.
sensitivity.authority: Cochrane Handbook 10.14: sensitivity analyses ask whether the conclusions are robust to decisions made during the review. Here the decision under test is the inclusion of each individual trial, not the estimator -- the estimator comparison is reported separately at `estimator_sensitivity`, because they are different questions and presenting them in one table would let a stable point estimate under one read as stability under the other.
sensitivity.conclusion: AT k=3 THE POOL IS LARGELY ONE TRIAL. CARAVAGGIO contributes 78 of the 108 events in this pool; its two companions contribute 30 between them. Omitting it moves the point estimate from 0.776 to 1.021, and the span across all three leave-one-out fits is 0.690 to 1.021. All three intervals span the null, so no single trial is holding the conclusion up -- and none is holding it down either. The honest reading is that this estimate is a description of CARAVAGGIO with two small trials attached.
sensitivity.interval_method: REML with a floored Knapp-Hartung interval on k-1 df, the same as the pool itself. At k=2 that is t on ONE degree of freedom, whose critical value is 12.7 -- which is why these intervals are enormous and why they should be.  [RESTATED 2026-08-20: the estimator moved to REML under DECISIONS-COCHRANE-2026-08-18.md section 1, on Cochrane Handbook 6.5 section 10.10.4.4: "Decision: REML, everywhere." The INTERVAL method is unchanged. Every fit under this label was refitted with REML and checked against its stored value by ssot/reml_apx_treatment_sensitivity_check.R, which reproduces all three leave-one-out analyses to four decimals and refuses if any does not.]
sensitivity.interval_method_superseded_2026_08_20: Paule-Mandel with a floored Knapp-Hartung interval on k-1 df, the same as the pool itself. At k=2 that is t on ONE degree of freedom, whose critical value is 12.7 -- which is why these intervals are enormous and why they should be.

estimator_sensitivity.note: THE SAME POINT ESTIMATE AND A MUCH NARROWER INTERVAL: 0.5356 to 1.1251 against 0.3437 to 1.7532. The difference is entirely the t multiplier on 2 degrees of freedom against 1.96, and it is the difference between an interval that looks like an answer and one that admits k=3. The wider one is reported.

each_trials_own_primary.refused_because: THREE OF THE EIGHT REGISTER A BLEEDING ENDPOINT AS THEIR PRIMARY -- COBRRA, COVET and the Japanese study. Pooling 'each trial's own primary' would average a HARM against a BENEFIT, and the pooled quantity would have no direction: a risk ratio below one would mean fewer thromboses in five trials and fewer bleeds in three. This is the only declined pool in this file that is refused as INCOMPUTABLE rather than computed and set aside, and the reason is stated so a reader can check that it is a reason and not a preference.

derivation_refused_with_its_arithmetic.what_was_refused: reconstructing a recurrent-VTE-alone estimand for AMPLIFY and AMPLIFY-EXT by summing the components they post separately
derivation_refused_with_its_arithmetic.why_refused: The components sum to 61 and 76 against a posted composite of 59 and 71. A composite counts a participant's FIRST event; its components count participants. Summing them would have manufactured 2 and 5 events that the trial's own adjudication does not record, and the manufactured events fall in the comparator arm at more than twice the rate they fall in the apixaban arm -- so the derivation is not merely imprecise, it is biased in the direction that flatters the drug.
derivation_refused_with_its_arithmetic.amplify_ext_note: The same check on AMPLIFY-EXT gives a much larger discrepancy -- placebo components 72 + 37 + 26 = 135 against a posted composite of 92 -- which first-event counting alone does not explain. No explanation is offered here because none was read; the refusal does not depend on having one.

the_duplicate_a_text_match_cannot_settle.what: Its primary composite is posted TWICE, typed PRIMARY both times, under the same registered name, differing only in the trailing 'Randomized Population With Imputation' / 'Without Imputation'.
the_duplicate_a_text_match_cannot_settle.why_it_matters: P35 says match the registered text and never the position. Here the text matches TWO posted measures and the values differ by more than half again on the treatment arms. CHOOSING AMONG MATCHES BY POSITION IS P35's OWN DEFECT ONE LEVEL DOWN, and nothing in the payload is malformed.
the_duplicate_a_text_match_cannot_settle.how_it_was_settled: By reading the descriptions, not the order: the WITHOUT-imputation record states 'No imputation was done for these endpoints', marking it as the sensitivity analysis, and the WITH-imputation record names the imputed counts in its own population description. The with-imputation analysis is used, the choice is applied to every measure taken from this trial, and both pools are computed so the choice's cost is visible rather than asserted to be small.

prediction_stated_before_the_run.prediction: The estimand-COHERENT, comparator-INCOHERENT pool (AMPLIFY + AMPLIFY-EXT) will show heterogeneity AT LEAST AS HIGH as the name-matched eight-trial pool, whose estimands do not agree at all.
prediction_stated_before_the_run.why_this_indicator_and_not_another: P32: name a quantity that could not move for another reason. A high I2 on the name-matched pool would be consistent with the estimands disagreeing AND with ordinary clinical variation, so it tests nothing on its own. The COMPARISON is the test: if the pool where the estimand IS shared is the more heterogeneous, then I2 is not tracking estimand coherence, and it cannot be doing so by coincidence in the direction that favours us.
prediction_stated_before_the_run.what_it_does_NOT_establish: Nothing about whether either pool is coherent. P36 stands unchanged: the coherence judgements in this file were made by reading definitions and would be identical if every I2 came out zero.

resolved_2026_08_21.the_text_that_decides_it: RoB 2 guidance 2019, Box 4, signalling question 1.1: "Answer 'No information' if the only information about randomization methods is a statement that the study is randomized." And section 4.4: "A judgement of low risk of bias requires that the trial has an adequate method of concealing the allocation sequence from those involved in enrolling participants, and there are no concerns about generation of the allocation sequence." Cochrane Handbook 6.5 section 8.3 names the domain's three components.
resolved_2026_08_21.why_this_is_not_an_adjudicated_dispute: A blind second assessor from a different model family disagreed with this domain on 89% of judgements across 22 topics. THAT WOULD ORDINARILY BE A DISPUTE TO ADJUDICATE. It is not one: the tool's own text names this exact evidential situation -- a bare statement that a study was randomised -- and prescribes the answer. The second assessor is not being deferred to; the guidance is being applied.
resolved_2026_08_21.what_the_registry_gives_and_does_not: A ClinicalTrials.gov design module records `allocation: RANDOMIZED`. It carries no sequence-generation method and no allocation-concealment mechanism. The original judgement's own note said so before scoring LOW.
resolved_2026_08_21.how_this_maps_to_the_tool_s_algorithm: The tool maps 'No information' on 1.1 and 1.2 with no baseline concern to a DOMAIN judgement of SOME CONCERNS. This project writes NO_INFORMATION on the domain when it could not be judged from the sources read, and caps the OVERALL at SOME_CONCERNS. Same place, and it keeps 'we could not judge this' distinguishable from 'we judged it and had concerns'.
resolved_2026_08_21.what_does_not_change: NO OVERALL RATING AND NO GRADE CERTAINTY MOVES. All 51 judgements were already capped at SOME_CONCERNS or HIGH by another NO_INFORMATION domain.
resolved_2026_08_21.what_would_close_it_properly: The trial publications or protocols, which carry sequence generation and concealment. Neither was read. Until one is, LOW is not available on this domain for any result in this corpus.

Cochrane Handbook 6.5 section 8.3 names the domain's three components.

steps.reason: All three contributing results are SOME CONCERNS overall, and all three are open-label. Two are secondary outcomes selected by this review from among registered ranks.

I-squared 0% over k=3: not rated down. A LOW I-SQUARED DOES NOT SHOW THE TRIALS MEASURE THE SAME THING -- on this very page the pool with the SHARED estimand comes out at 93.5%. Coherence is handled under indirectness, where it belongs.

The three comparators are NOT the same comparator: dalteparin, rivaroxaban, and unfractionated heparin followed by warfarin. The estimand is shared and the contrast is not, so the pooled quantity is 'apixaban against whatever else was given', which is one step from any question a reader has. Stated rather than absorbed into heterogeneity.

k=3, 3,933 participants, 61 events in total, and the Knapp-Hartung interval runs 0.34 to 1.75 -- consistent with a two-thirds reduction and with a three-quarters increase. This is the honest width and it is why the review's answer is 'not established' rather than 'no difference'.
k=3. A funnel plot or Egger test at k=3 has no power and would be theatre. NOT ASSESSED, and not counted as absent.

recurrent_vte.and_what_the_rating_is_NOT_about: VERY LOW certainty here is not a claim that apixaban is ineffective in acute VTE. It is a claim about WHAT THIS REVIEW CAN SHOW from three trials on one shared estimand. The largest trials in the field are excluded from this pool for a reason recorded on this page, and their results are not smuggled into the certainty rating by implication.

manuscript.introduction:
This review asks: In adults with acute or recent venous thromboembolism, what is the effect of apixaban compared with conventional anticoagulation, another direct oral anticoagulant, or placebo on recurrent venous thromboembolism and on bleeding?

It pools 3 randomised trials, against another anticoagulant.

The outcome pooled is Recurrent symptomatic venous thromboembolism -- nonfatal deep vein thrombosis or nonfatal pulmonary embolism -- with NO death term.

Everything in this paragraph is derived from stored fields and none of it is authored. The interpretive sentences that follow are marked as drafts and are the author's to replace.

bookkeeping_2026_08_21._what: The five reporting claims a PRISMA-2020 manuscript needs that are FETCHABLE rather than argued -- each derived from a field here, or stated as an honest absence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.which_limbs_this_review_refuses: Of the four properties this project requires of a completed topic, 3 are held (grade per pool, model output verbatim, rob per result) and 1 are refused with the obstacle named in the evidence (comparison denominator).

bookkeeping_2026_08_21.whether_this_review_was_prospectively_re: NO PROSPERO REGISTRATION OR PROTOCOL RECORD IS HELD ON THIS OBJECT. That is not the same as knowing this review was not registered, and neither claim is made. It is recorded here as an absence so that a reader does not have to infer it from silence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.that_two_assessors_disagreed_and_where: Risk of bias was assessed independently a second time by GPT-5 Codex (openai family), via `codex exec`, blind to this assessment and given the same registry facts. 3 of 18 judgements -- 16.7%. Reported as DISAGREEMENT: agreement between two assessors given the same facts authenticates nothing. By domain: D1 3 of 3 disagree, D2 0 of 3 disagree, D3 0 of 3 disagree, D4 0 of 3 disagree, D5 0 of 3 disagree, OVERALL 0 of 3 disagree. Recounted after this review's D1 judgements moved: 0 of 18 judgements -- 0.0%.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.which_risk_of_bias_domains_drove_the_rat: Where a result is rated worse than LOW overall, the domain carrying that judgement is: D4 on 3 result(s), D5 on 2 result(s). The overall rating is the worst domain, so these are the domains that determine it.
